'''March 2003 Ames tournament''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG local tournament held at Mayhem Comics in Ames, Iowa, on 29 March 2003, run by [[Steve Florent]].<ref name="pcf-2228-33753">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=33753#33753 Anybody interested in Iowa tournaments??], Steve Florent (hawkeyespf), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (29 September 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040309014127/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=39671%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-2228-35134">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=35134#35134 Anybody interested in Iowa tournaments??], Steve Florent (hawkeyespf), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (3 November 2003). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040309014127/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=39671%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Just enough players came for the event to be sanctioned with Florent playing, which he did. He split a box of [[Revised Dagobah|white-border Dagobah]] boosters among all the players and gave the winner about 10 packs.<ref name="pcf-2228-33753" />

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Mayhem Comics, Ames, Iowa<ref name="pcf-2228-33753" />
* '''Dates:''' 29 March 2003<ref name="pcf-2228-33753" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Steve Florent]]<ref name="pcf-2228-33753" />

== Results ==

No results were posted.
